## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`objectstack-data` 技能的对象能力表(`enable`)加一行 `aiReadable`:只用于平台系统对象(`sys_*`,不含 `sys_metadata`、`sys_metadata_history`),开放只读 AI 访问(查询、取单条、聚合、describe、列表,永不写);应用对象从不声明它,连 `false` 也会在解析时被拒。
- 为什么改:#32971 新增了 `enable.aiReadable`,技能文字没教,AI 照着能力表写应用对象时既不知道它存在,也不知道写在业务对象上会被拒。
- 风险与回滚:纯技能文字,一个文件加 1 行,外加一个 `@objectstack/skills` patch changeset;不动 schema、不动运行时;回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` 第 121 行(能力表最后一行)。
- 两分钟验证:`git diff origin/main -- skills/`,预期只见能力表末尾新增 `aiReadable` 一行,默认列为 `—`。
- 需要你做的:受管面 Tier H(`skills/**`):请批准或合并。

## What changes

- **`skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md`, Object Capabilities (`enable`) table**, one row after `clone`:

  `| aiReadable | — | Platform sys_* objects only (not sys_metadata, sys_metadata_history): read-only AI access (query, get, aggregate, describe, list; no write). App objects never declare it, false included: refused at parse |`

  (backticks around the identifiers in the file). The Default column reads `—`, not `false`: an absent key is closed, and writing `false` on an app object is itself refused, so a `false` default would invite the one value that fails.
- **`.changeset/32974-skills-enable-ai-readable-row.md`**: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, carrying both declaration lines.

## Why

Read on `origin/main` ba35dfd7, `packages/spec/src/data/ai-read-exposure.ts`:

- `aiReadExposureRefusal(objectName, enable)` judges any declared value (`false` included; only an absent or `undefined` key passes) in this order: first the stored-metadata family (`isStoredMetadataBodyObject`, `STORED_METADATA_BODY_OBJECTS` = `sys_metadata`, `sys_metadata_history`, in `packages/spec/src/kernel/stored-metadata-body-objects.ts`) is refused whatever the key says; then a `sys_` name (`/^sys_/i`) is accepted; every other name is refused ("is not a system object ... Remove it").
- `ObjectSchema`'s refinement calls it through `refuseMisplacedAiReadExposure` (`object.zod.ts`), so every door that parses an object refuses it: `ObjectSchema.create`, `defineStack`, `os validate` and the object save door.
- `isAiReadExposed(schema)` answers `true` only for the boolean `true` on a `sys_*` object outside that family.
- The key is live after #32442: `isAiReadExposed` is read by `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts`, `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts` and `packages/mcp/src/stdio-data-bridge.ts`, and two platform objects declare it (`sys_user` in `platform-objects`, `sys_approval_request` in `plugin-approvals`). The `.describe` text in `ObjectCapabilities` says the same as the new row.

## Acceptance notes

- No eval is added or extended: no eval under `skills/objectstack-data/evals/` asks for the `enable` table (the only `trackHistory` hit is a `must_not_contain` in a lifecycle eval), and `objects-fields-relationships.json` and `rules/relationships.md` belong to open PRs #33394 and #33427 and are untouched.
- The order expected `SKILL.md` might sit at its token ceiling; measured headroom was 59 tokens before the row and 0 after, so no other text was cut and no ceiling moved. The review round's fix (naming the two refused objects) was paid inside the row itself (`never a write` to `no write`, `An app object never declares` to `App objects never declare`).
